description: Guard against scoreboard-collapse: run-acceptance.py must distinguish PASS(0) / FAIL(1) / INVOCATION(2) / PARSE(3) / BLOCK(4) so a BLOCKed criterion can't masquerade as PASS in the operator scoreboard (SYNTHESIS row #15 anti-cheat).

evals.task: When all remaining criteria are BLOCKED by the safety deny list and none FAILED, run-acceptance.py must return exit code 4 (not 0, not 1). The previous binary logic returned 0, which let BLOCKed criteria masquerade as PASS.
success_criteria: results.json contains at least 1 criterion with status blocked
results.json contains 0 criteria with status failed
results.json contains 0 criteria with status passed
